results.title: COMPETENCY: Excel Export sustains a usable rows-per-second
results.evidence: status=completed; 40 rows in 5.0s = 7.93 rows/sec (want >= 5.0); 1000 rows would take ~2.1 min
results.xfail_reason: FOUND 2026-08-02: Database -> Excel Export sustains 0.66 ROWS/SEC (~1.5 s/row), linear in row count. Three independent measurements on an IDLE executor agree to two decimals: 40 rows/60.6s, 120 rows/182.9s, and a live sample of a 1000-row export = 0.66-0.67 rows/sec; the small tier-1/2 exports fit the same line (1 row 3.1s, 2 rows 5.3s, 10 rows 15.7-17.2s). So 1,000 rows takes ~25 minutes and 10,000 rows ~4 hours - a realistic export is effectively unusable. Correctness is fine: a 1000-row export DID write all 1000 rows, it just took ~30 min. Tiers 1-2 never saw this because they only ever export 2 or 10 rows. OWNER DECISION PENDING.
